nodes.description: mapping(address=>uint256) private _rOwned: reflection balances per account
mapping(address=>uint256) private _tOwned: token balances for excluded accounts
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint256)) private _allowances: ERC20 allowances
mapping(address=>bool) private _isExcludedFromFee: fee exemption whitelist
mapping(address=>bool) private _isExcluded: reflection-reward exclusion flag
address[] private _excluded: list of reward-excluded accounts
uint256 private _tTotal: total token supply
uint256 private _rTotal: total reflection supply
uint256 private _tFeeTotal: accumulated fee tokens
uint256 public _taxFee: reflection tax percentage
uint256 public _liquidityFee: liquidity fee percentage
IUniswapV2Router02 public immutable uniswapV2Router
address public immutable uniswapV2Pair
address payable public _charityWalletAddress: recipient of swapped fees
bool inSwapAndLiquify: reentrancy guard flag for swap/liquify
bool public swapAndLiquifyEnabled: toggle for automatic swap
uint256 public _maxTxAmount: max transfer amount
uint256 private numTokensSellToAddToLiquidity: swap trigger threshold
address private _owner: Ownable owner
address private _previousOwner: owner stored during lock
uint256 private _lockTime: timestamp until which ownership is locked
constructor(address payable charityWalletAddress): sets supply, router, pair and fee exemptions
transfer(address recipient,uint256 amount): entry point delegating to _transfer
transferFrom(address sender,address recipient,uint256 amount): allowance-based transfer
approve(address spender,uint256 amount): sets allowance for msg.sender
_transfer(address from,address to,uint256 amount): core transfer logic, fee logic and swap trigger
_tokenTransfer(address sender,address recipient,uint256 amount,bool takeFee): dispatches transfer variant and toggles fees
swapAndLiquify(uint256 contractTokenBalance) private lockTheSwap: splits balance, swaps, adds liquidity, sends ETH to charity
swapTokensForEth(uint256 tokenAmount): external swap of tokens to ETH on the router
addLiquidity(uint256 tokenAmount,uint256 ethAmount): external addLiquidityETH on the router
sendBNBToCharity(uint256 amount): swaps tokens then transfers full ETH balance to charity wallet
lock(uint256 time) public virtual onlyOwner: transfers ownership away and stores unlock timestamp
unlock() public virtual: restores previous owner after _lockTime using block timestamp
deliver(uint256 tAmount): removes reflections from caller and credits total fees
excludeFromReward(address account) public onlyOwner: excludes account from reflection rewards
includeInReward(address account) external onlyOwner: re-includes account into reflection rewards
setMaxTxPercent(uint256 maxTxPercent) external onlyOwner: updates _maxTxAmount
setTaxFeePercent(uint256 taxFee) external onlyOwner: updates _taxFee
setLiquidityFeePercent(uint256 liquidityFee) external onlyOwner: updates _liquidityFee
setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(bool _enabled) public onlyOwner: toggles automatic swap
_setCharityWallet(address payable charityWalletAddress) external onlyOwner: changes charity address
receive() external payable: accepts ETH from the router during swaps
_takeLiquidity(uint256 tLiquidity) private: moves liquidity fee into the contract address
_reflectFee(uint256 rFee,uint256 tFee) private: reduces _rTotal and increases _tFeeTotal
_getValues(uint256 tAmount) private view: computes r/t amount, fee and liquidity values
calculateTaxFee(uint256 _amount) private view: tAmount * _taxFee / 100
calculateLiquidityFee(uint256 _amount) private view: tAmount * _liquidityFee / 100
removeAllFee() private: caches and zeroes tax and liquidity fees
restoreAllFee() private: restores cached tax and liquidity fees
msg.sender: external caller address used for ownership, allowance and transfer checks
block.timestamp: used as swap deadline and for the ownership lock/unlock timing
recipient.call{value: amount}("") in Address.sendValue: unchecked low-level ETH call that forwards all gas
uniswapV2Router.swapExactTokensForETHSupportingFeeOnTransferTokens(...) with 0 min-out slippage
uniswapV2Router.addLiquidityETH{value: ethAmount}(...) with 0 slippage minimums
_charityWalletAddress.transfer(address(this).balance): sends entire ETH balance to an external address
require(now > _lockTime) in unlock(): ownership restoration gated on miner-influenceable block timestamp
_lockTime = now + time: unchecked addition on block.timestamp in lock()
parameter from of _transfer
parameter to of _transfer
parameter amount of _transfer
parameter tAmount of deliver
parameter time of lock, added to block.timestamp
local contractTokenBalance in _transfer and swapAndLiquify
local halfOfLiquify = contractTokenBalance/4 in swapAndLiquify
local otherHalfOfLiquify = contractTokenBalance/4 in swapAndLiquify
local newBalance: ETH obtained from the swap, fed into addLiquidity
parameter sender of _tokenTransfer
parameter recipient of _tokenTransfer
parameter account of excludeFromReward
parameter _enabled of setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled
parameter maxTxPercent of setMaxTxPercent

edges.reason: msg.sender is passed as the transfer origin into transfer()
msg.sender is the spender whose allowance is decremented in transferFrom()
msg.sender is the allowance owner in approve()
msg.sender becomes the from argument reaching _transfer
onlyOwner on lock() compares msg.sender (via _msgSender) with _owner
unlock() requires _previousOwner == msg.sender before restoring ownership
excludeFromReward is restricted to the owner identified through msg.sender
includeInReward is restricted to the owner identified through msg.sender
setMaxTxPercent is gated by the onlyOwner modifier on msg.sender
setTaxFeePercent is gated by the onlyOwner modifier on msg.sender
setLiquidityFeePercent is gated by the onlyOwner modifier on msg.sender
setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled is gated by the onlyOwner modifier on msg.sender
_setCharityWallet is gated by the onlyOwner modifier on msg.sender
block.timestamp (now) is stored into _lockTime in lock()
unlock() authority depends on miner-controllable block.timestamp versus _lockTime
block.timestamp feeds the now > _lockTime ownership check
block.timestamp is added to time without overflow checks in lock()
block.timestamp is used as the swap deadline in swapTokensForEth
block.timestamp is used as the addLiquidityETH deadline
from parameter drives zero-address check, pair check and state updates
to parameter drives zero-address check and state updates
amount parameter is validated against _maxTxAmount and forwarded to _tokenTransfer
tAmount parameter is converted into rAmount and deducted from the caller
time parameter is added to now to compute the lock deadline
contractTokenBalance is split and swapped inside swapAndLiquify
halfOfLiquify is the token amount swapped for ETH
otherHalfOfLiquify is paired with the received ETH in addLiquidity
newBalance (ETH from the swap) is supplied as ethAmount to addLiquidity
sender parameter selects the transfer variant and is used for _isExcluded lookups
recipient parameter selects the transfer variant and receives the tokens
account parameter is pushed into _excluded and flagged in _isExcluded
_enabled parameter is written into swapAndLiquifyEnabled
maxTxPercent parameter scales _tTotal into the new _maxTxAmount
_transfer reads inSwapAndLiquify to avoid recursive swap-and-liquify
_transfer enforces amount <= _maxTxAmount
_transfer checks swapAndLiquifyEnabled before triggering the swap
_transfer compares from against uniswapV2Pair to avoid circular liquidity events
_transfer consults _isExcludedFromFee to decide whether fees apply
lockTheSwap modifier sets and clears inSwapAndLiquify around the external calls
_tokenTransfer fee handling depends on _taxFee through calculateTaxFee
_tokenTransfer fee handling depends on _liquidityFee through calculateLiquidityFee
_getValues reads _taxFee when computing tFee
_getValues reads _liquidityFee when computing tLiquidity
swapTokensForEth calls WETH()/swap on uniswapV2Router
addLiquidity calls addLiquidityETH on uniswapV2Router
sendBNBToCharity forwards the ETH balance to _charityWalletAddress
deliver subtracts rAmount from the caller's _rOwned balance
deliver reduces _rTotal by rAmount
deliver increases _tFeeTotal by tAmount
_takeLiquidity credits the liquidity reflections to address(this) in _rOwned
_reflectFee reduces _rTotal by rFee
_reflectFee increases _tFeeTotal by tFee
setMaxTxPercent writes the computed value into _maxTxAmount
setTaxFeePercent writes taxFee into _taxFee
setLiquidityFeePercent writes liquidityFee into _liquidityFee
setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled writes _enabled into swapAndLiquifyEnabled
_setCharityWallet overwrites _charityWalletAddress
lock() moves _owner into _previousOwner and zeroes _owner
lock() stores the current owner in _previousOwner
lock() writes the unlock timestamp into _lockTime
unlock() restores _owner from _previousOwner
unlock() requires _previousOwner == msg.sender
unlock() reads _lockTime for the timestamp comparison
unchecked now + time result is stored into _lockTime
swapTokensForEth performs the external router swap with zero minimum output
addLiquidity performs the external router liquidity call with zero slippage bounds
sendBNBToCharity pushes the entire contract ETH balance to an external wallet
excludeFromReward sets _isExcluded[account] to true
excludeFromReward seeds _tOwned[account] from the reflection balance
includeInReward clears _isExcluded[account] to false
constructor assigns the immutable uniswapV2Router
constructor creates and stores uniswapV2Pair
constructor stores the initial _charityWalletAddress
transfer delegates to _transfer
transferFrom delegates to _transfer before updating the allowance
_transfer routes the amount, from and to into _tokenTransfer with the takeFee flag
_transfer triggers swapAndLiquify when the contract balance exceeds the threshold
swapAndLiquify calls swapTokensForEth for half of the tokens
swapAndLiquify calls addLiquidity with the swapped ETH
swapAndLiquify calls sendBNBToCharity for the remaining portion
sendBNBToCharity first swaps tokens for ETH before transferring
_tokenTransfer path allocates the liquidity fee through _takeLiquidity
_tokenTransfer path reflects the tax fee through _reflectFee
_getValues calls calculateTaxFee
_getValues calls calculateLiquidityFee
_transfer transitively reaches _takeLiquidity during fee accounting
_transfer transitively reaches _reflectFee during fee accounting
the router swap transfers tokens, re-entering _transfer; mitigated by the inSwapAndLiquify lockTheSwap guard
the ETH transfer to _charityWalletAddress executes external code that could re-enter the transfer path
addLiquidityETH on the pair can invoke token callbacks while swapAndLiquify is executing

normalization_plan.reason: local parameter from only carries the sender value through _transfer and has no independent state
local parameter to only carries the recipient value through _transfer
local parameter amount is consumed by the _transfer checks and fee logic
tAmount is only used to derive rAmount and update totals inside deliver
time is only used to compute the _lockTime deadline inside lock
contractTokenBalance is a temporary split value local to the swap-and-liquify flow
halfOfLiquify is a derived local used only for the token-to-ETH swap
otherHalfOfLiquify is a derived local used only for the liquidity addition
newBalance is the ETH amount produced by the swap and passed straight into addLiquidity
sender selects the transfer variant in _tokenTransfer and has no standalone state
recipient selects the transfer variant in _tokenTransfer and has no standalone state
account is only used to update _isExcluded and _tOwned inside excludeFromReward
maxTxPercent is only used to recompute _maxTxAmount
